primary_rule: Under constant relative speed, predict future TTC <= 3 s within 3 s when current valid TTC <= 6 s (target threshold + horizon).
secondary_rule: Under constant relative speed, predict contact within 3 s when current valid TTC <= 3 s.
limitations: The rules assume current relative speed persists and ignore acceleration, changing gaps, and other traffic. TTC cutoffs are provisional surrogate criteria.
